description:
With over 2400 puzzles, tons of new Clutter variations mixed in with old favorites, and a variety of clever mini-games, 
Clutter RefleXIVe: The Diceman Cometh offers a clutter quest you'll never forget! 
You'll face challenging puzzles, including Sliders, Square Jigsaws, Box Quotes, while you triumph over a huge collection of clutter puzzles! 
Gear up for a mind-bending, cluttered mess of fun!
name: Clutter RefleXIVe: The Diceman Cometh Collector's Edition
intro: Ultra challenging Clutter yet, with over 2400 puzzles!
